Competition metrics for every US metro and micro area, 2019

Source: R/cbsa-metrics-data.R
cbsa_metrics.Rd

Output of get_all_metrics() for every core-based statistical area (CBSA) in the SOI panel sample frame, tax year 2019, 501(c)(3) filers only, measured on total revenue. One row per CBSA and NTEE major group, plus one SUB = "ALL" row per CBSA. National rollups are left out. Used by the vignettes for cross-market comparisons; built by data-raw/create-cbsa-metrics.R.

Usage

cbsa_metrics

Format

A data frame with 11,938 rows and 22 columns:

GEO

CBSA code

SUB

NTEE major group (the first three characters of NTEEV2, the NCCS equivalent of the 12 NTMAJ12 groups), or "ALL"

YEAR

Tax year (2019)

N

Number of organizations; 0 for subsectors with no organizations in that CBSA

POP

CBSA population; NA for a few CBSAs missing from the population table

TOTREV

Summed total revenue

EXPECTED_N, EXPECTED_TOTREV

Count and revenue expected for a market of this population, from the density models

DENSITY_PCTL_N, DENSITY_PCTL_R

Scale-free density of the count and of revenue, from get_scale_free_density()

GINI, HHI, NHHI, KWOKA

Gini coefficient, Herfindahl-Hirschman index, normalized HHI and Kwoka dominance index; NA when N = 0

CR1, CR2, CR3, CR4, CR5, CR6, CR7, CR8

Concentration ratios

Source

NCCS SOI panel sample frame, https://nccs.urban.org/
